newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: FENCING-SRECKI CLAIMS SECOND WORLD CROWN.
newsitem.headline: FENCING-SRECKI CLAIMS SECOND WORLD CROWN.

text.p: Former Olympic champion Erick Srecki of France claimed his second world title in the men's epee on Tuesday.
He defeated twice world champion Pavel Kolobkov of Russia 15-14 after forcing the bout into extra time by scoring an equalising hit four seconds from the end of the final period.
Italy's Giovanna Trillini completed a more comfortable women's foil victory over Germany's experienced Sabine Bau to add a world crown to the one she won in 1991. Trillini cruised home 15-10.
